_about: CSV batch 3: rows from the user's regional tech-company CSV, each verified against public sources 2026-10-03. Same rules as real-companies.json: every row carries the sources it was taken from, nothing is inferred or invented, and a field that could not be sourced is null. Headcount and founded never come from aggregators. Coordinates come from the Mapbox Geocoding API applied to the sourced street address; rows without a sourced street address have null coordinates and a district taken from the sourced city.
